items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Then I did a week in the Baby Grand with Joe Turner and then I made some recordings with Sarah Vaughan.

ctx.x: Well 'Open the Door Richard' was a comedian, Dusty Fletcher, you see. And how that happened, Jack McVea had made a record on the coast and it was caught on fire and so we had to record this right quick. And that's how I did that with him. Then I did a week in the Baby Grand
with Joe Turner and then I made some recordings with Sarah Vaughan.
You did make some recordings with Sarah Vaughan?
